title: Figure 4: field-reversed configuration (FRC) plasma confinement diagram
description: Cross-section diagram of an elongated plasma ellipsoid inside axial field coils, with coloured contour lines marking closed poloidal field lines, open magnetic field lines, the separatrix, radii rs and rc, and a B=0 null region. Captioned "Figure 4. Field-Reversed Configuration." The text compares spheromaks and FRCs and then introduces inertial confinement fusion and the DOE National Ignition Facility.
